meta.tagging: Word tokens via scambranch.checks.WORD_RE; tag en if wordfreq zipf_frequency(w,'en')>=3.5, else local if in render.local_lexicon(profile), else untagged. English share = n_en/(n_en+n_local). CMI (Gambäck & Das 2016) = 100*(1-max(n_lang)/(n-n_u)) with n_u=untagged. Switch points = adjacent tagged-label changes; normalized by n_tagged.

code_mixing.method: Word tokens via scambranch.checks.WORD_RE; tag en if wordfreq zipf_frequency(w,'en')>=3.5, else local if in render.local_lexicon(profile), else untagged. English share = n_en/(n_en+n_local). CMI (Gambäck & Das 2016) = 100*(1-max(n_lang)/(n-n_u)) with n_u=untagged. Switch points = adjacent tagged-label changes; normalized by n_tagged.

lexical_diversity.method: Tokens via WORD_RE lowercased. TTR on contiguous 10000-token windows (mean of 20 random starts). MATTR window=50. Zipf: OLS log freq ~ log rank for ranks 1..min(1000,V). Heaps: OLS log V ~ log N on cumulative growth.

distributional.caveat: Reference sources are tweets, QA, and service dialogues — not phone-call transcripts. JSD / OOV / bits-per-char are upper-bound-of-mismatch indicators, not naturalness scores.

romanization.method: Clusters from language_profile romanization_variants with kind=corpus_cluster and >=2 variants. For each corpus (synthetic turns / reference utterances), count how many variants of each cluster appear; report share of clusters with >1 attested variant and mean Shannon entropy over variant counts within cluster.

probes.method: sklearn TfidfVectorizer(word 1-2grams, min_df=2) + LogisticRegression (liblinear for binary label probes; lbfgs for 4-way condition; class_weight=balanced). C chosen on dev by macro-F1. Test macro-F1 with 95% bootstrap CI over 2000 resamples of the 12 test scenario families with replacement (seed 42).
